{{Quote|Sergeant Troy! You will show our Padawan commander the proper respect, or you'll be heading the charge without a blaster.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Herc]] chastising [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Troy]] for disrespecting [[Bant Eerin's Padawan]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Akoshissss''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] moon of [[Akoshissss]]. The main point of the battle was to destroy [[Bitt Panith]]'s [[Bitt Panith's secret base|secret base]] that was located on the [[Akoshissss|moon]]. There were three divisions in the battle plan: one to lead the battle and destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]], one to infiltrate the base once the shield was down, set charges inside, and destroy it, and one person who would go to [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] and persuade the locals not to get mixed up in the conflict. In the end, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] won the battle and the base was destroyed.
